paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: Q-WAM estimates how per-layer activation rounding affects the final generated action and uses that sensitivity to protect action subspaces during W4A4 quantization. It therefore subsumes the broad claim that WAM quantization should be guided by downstream action fidelity, but it evaluates the full generated chunk and adds a low-rank 16-bit branch; it does not optimize the exact fixed-controller executed prefix with a branch-first command objective. The candidate already labels its narrower delta as application-level and incremental.

falsification_structure_check.reasoning: The candidate specifies paired, trajectory-disjoint reference logs, two W4A8 comparators, and a lower held-out executed-command error prediction. Its pairing shuffle is scored on that downstream command-error metric rather than on branch mismatch itself; the paragraph makes no numerical outcome-bar claim.

phase3_critique/phase3_critique_output.j.verdict_rationale: Q-WAM already establishes WAM action-sensitive quantization, so the surviving delta is the exact fixed-controller executed-prefix command objective and branch-prioritized W4A8 scale search, not general action-aware PTQ. PreDE also uses fixed-observation full-action deviation to screen WAM quantization candidates, which further limits the novelty claim; the candidate already calls itself application-level/incremental and scopes evidence to fixed-input command fidelity. The falsification structure is sound and no blocking B findings were supplied, so advance is appropriate only as a scoped proposal.
